summary: This bill amends the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to require the consideration and use of "resource preservation techniques"—which include water and energy efficiency, stormwater mitigation, and sustainable planning—in various water infrastructure programs and grants, and reauthorizes funding for related programs.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to amend the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to promote 'resource preservation techniques' in water infrastructure programs. These techniques include water efficiency, energy efficiency, stormwater mitigation, and sustainable project planning, all of which directly contribute to environmental protection and sustainability. The bill also increases funding for wastewater efficiency and clean water infrastructure resiliency programs, further enhancing environmental protection efforts.
